poses: Anticipation crouch: knees deeply bent, arms swung back, body low and coiled
Take-off: legs fully extended pushing off the toes, arms thrown upward, body stretched tall
Apex: in the air, knees tucked up, arms out for balance
Fall: in the air, legs extended down reaching for the ground, arms raised slightly
Landing: knees deeply bent absorbing impact, arms forward for balance, feet planted
notes: `poses/jump.txt`. In Godot, choose the frame by vertical velocity: 1-2 take-off, 3 apex, 4 fall, 5 land.
